<template>
	<AsamButton plain @click="open('')"> Default </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton plain type="success" @click="open('success')"> Success </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton plain type="warning" @click="open('warning')"> Warning </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton plain type="danger" @click="open('error')"> Error </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton plain type="info" @click="open('info')"> Info </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton plain @click="openCustomColor"> Custom color </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton plain @click="openWithoutPause"> No pause on hover </AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamNotification,
	type AsamNotificationHandle,
	type AsamNotificationType
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

function open(type: AsamNotificationType) {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: `${type || 'Default'} progress`,
			message: 'Hover to pause the timer and progress bar',
			type,
			duration: 6000,
			progress: true
		})
	);
}

function openWithoutPause() {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: 'No pause on hover',
			message: 'Timer and progress bar keep running even when hovering',
			duration: 6000,
			progress: true,
			pauseOnHover: false
		})
	);
}

function openCustomColor() {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: 'Custom color',
			message: 'Custom progress bar color overrides the default',
			duration: 6000,
			progress: {
				color: [
					{ color: '#f56c6c', percentage: 20 },
					{ color: '#e6a23c', percentage: 40 },
					{ color: '#5cb87a', percentage: 60 },
					{ color: '#1989fa', percentage: 80 },
					{ color: '#6f7ad3', percentage: 100 }
				]
			}
		})
	);
}

const ownedAsamNotification = new Set<AsamNotificationHandle>();
let mountedAsamNotification = true;
const trackAsamNotification = (handle: AsamNotificationHandle) => {
	if (mountedAsamNotification) ownedAsamNotification.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamNotification = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamNotification) handle.close();
	ownedAsamNotification.clear();
});
</script>
